summary: Iterate through dictionary keys together with their values.
documentation: items returns a view of the dictionary’s key/value pairs. The view reflects dictionary changes and can be used for pair unpacking in a loop. Build a separate result instead of changing its size during iteration.
inputs: A dictionary; items takes no arguments.
returns: A dynamic view of (key, value) pairs.
caution: Adding or deleting keys while iterating can raise RuntimeError. Sort the output explicitly for a deterministic report.
scenarios: Create field/value summaries for a client intake record.
Inspect SKU stock counts alongside their product identifiers.
Select configuration settings meeting a value condition.
title: List products needing restock
problem: Input is an object mapping product names to nonnegative integer quantities. Return an alphabetically sorted list of names whose quantity is less than 3.
goal: Use dict.items() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Unpack name and quantity from items, filter by quantity, then sort names.
